problem: Theme colors are hand-checked for contrast; nothing stops a future tweak from failing AA (d4)

shipped: Contrast unit test (4.5:1, both themes, no hard-coded text colors); dark-mode red badge fixed from 3.5:1 to 7.5:1 via --bad
